parts.name: Button
parts.Basic_description: A small plastic button located on the front of the toaster, typically used to control settings or cancel toasting.
parts.Functional_description: It allows the user to start, stop, or adjust the toasting process.
parts.Movement_description: It moves slightly inward when pressed and returns to its original position when released.

parts.name: Slider
parts.Basic_description: A vertical plastic lever on the toaster’s front face used to lower and raise the bread.
parts.Functional_description: It engages the internal heating mechanism and timer when pushed down.
parts.Movement_description: It moves vertically downward to start toasting and springs back up when the cycle completes.

parts.name: Bread (Other)
parts.Basic_description: A slice of bread placed in one of the toaster slots, made of organic material.
parts.Functional_description: It is the food item being toasted by the appliance.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during toasting and pops up when the cycle ends.

parts.name: Bread (Other)
parts.Basic_description: Another slice of bread placed in the second slot of the toaster.
parts.Functional_description: It is toasted simultaneously with the other slice.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during toasting and pops up when the cycle ends.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The main body of the toaster, made of stainless steel, housing the heating elements and internal mechanisms.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support, insulation, and protection for the internal components.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and does not move during operation.
